verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. عَلَى «ٱلسُّوسَنِّ». لِبَنِي قُورَحَ. قَصِيدَةٌ. تَرْنِيمَةُ مَحَبَّةٍ فَاضَ قَلْبِي بِكَلَامٍ صَالِحٍ. مُتَكَلِّمٌ أَنَا بِإِنْشَائِي لِلْمَلِكِ. لِسَانِي قَلَمُ كَاتِبٍ مَاهِرٍ.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves. My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue [is] the pen of a ready writer.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ أَبْرَعُ جَمَالًا مِنْ بَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ. ٱنْسَكَبَتِ ٱلنِّعْمَةُ عَلَى شَفَتَيْكَ، لِذَلِكَ بَارَكَكَ ٱللهُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.web: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

verses.ar: تَقَلَّدْ سَيْفَكَ عَلَى فَخْذِكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْجَبَّارُ، جَلَالَكَ وَبَهَاءَكَ.
verses.kjv: Gird thy sword upon [thy] thigh, O [most] mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.web: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

verses.ar: وَبِجَلَالِكَ ٱقْتَحِمِ. ٱرْكَبْ. مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلدَّعَةِ وَٱلْبِرِّ، فَتُرِيَكَ يَمِينُكَ مَخَاوِفَ.
verses.kjv: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
verses.web: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

verses.ar: نَبْلُكَ ٱلْمَسْنُونَةُ فِي قَلْبِ أَعْدَاءِ ٱلْمَلِكِ. شُعُوبٌ تَحْتَكَ يَسْقُطُونَ.
verses.kjv: Thine arrows [are] sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; [whereby] the people fall under thee.
verses.web: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

verses.ar: كُرْسِيُّكَ يَا ٱللهُ إِلَى دَهْرِ ٱلدُّهُورِ. قَضِيبُ ٱسْتِقَامَةٍ قَضِيبُ مُلْكِكَ.
verses.kjv: Thy throne, O God, [is] for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom [is] a right sceptre.
verses.web: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

verses.ar: أَحْبَبْتَ ٱلْبِرَّ وَأَبْغَضْتَ ٱلْإِثْمَ، مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ مَسَحَكَ ٱللهُ إِلَهُكَ بِدُهْنِ ٱلِٱبْتِهَاجِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ رُفَقَائِكَ.
verses.kjv: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.web: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

verses.ar: كُلُّ ثِيَابِكَ مُرٌّ وَعُودٌ وَسَلِيخَةٌ. مِنْ قُصُورِ ٱلْعَاجِ سَرَّتْكَ ٱلْأَوْتَارُ.
verses.kjv: All thy garments [smell] of myrrh, and aloes, [and] cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
verses.web: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

verses.ar: بَنَاتُ مُلُوكٍ بَيْنَ حَظِيَّاتِكَ. جُعِلَتِ ٱلْمَلِكَةُ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ بِذَهَبِ أُوفِيرٍ.
verses.kjv: Kings’ daughters [were] among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.web: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

verses.ar: اِسْمَعِي يَا بِنْتُ وَٱنْظُرِي، وَأَمِيلِي أُذُنَكِ، وَٱنْسَيْ شَعْبَكِ وَبَيْتَ أَبِيكِ،
verses.kjv: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;
verses.web: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

verses.ar: فَيَشْتَهِيَ ٱلْمَلِكُ حُسْنَكِ، لِأَنَّهُ هُوَ سَيِّدُكِ فَٱسْجُدِي لَهُ.
verses.kjv: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he [is] thy Lord; and worship thou him.
verses.web: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

verses.ar: وَبِنْتُ صُورٍ أَغْنَى ٱلشُّعُوبِ تَتَرَضَّى وَجْهَكِ بِهَدِيَّةٍ.
verses.kjv: And the daughter of Tyre [shall be there] with a gift; [even] the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
verses.web: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

verses.ar: كُلُّهَا مَجْدٌ ٱبْنَةُ ٱلْمَلِكِ فِي خِدْرِهَا. مَنْسُوجَةٌ بِذَهَبٍ مَلَابِسُهَا.
verses.kjv: The king’s daughter [is] all glorious within: her clothing [is] of wrought gold.
verses.web: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

verses.ar: بِمَلَابِسَ مُطَرَّزَةٍ تُحْضَرُ إِلَى ٱلْمَلِكِ. في إِثْرِهَا عَذَارَى صَاحِبَاتُهَا. مُقَدَّمَاتٌ إِلَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
verses.web: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

verses.ar: يُحْضَرْنَ بِفَرَحٍ وَٱبْتِهَاجٍ. يَدْخُلْنَ إِلَى قَصْرِ ٱلْمَلِكِ.
verses.kjv: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.web: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

verses.ar: عِوَضًا عَنْ آبَائِكَ يَكُونُ بَنُوكَ، تُقِيمُهُمْ رُؤَسَاءَ فِي كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
verses.web: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

verses.ar: أَذْكُرُ ٱسْمَكَ فِي كُلِّ دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ. مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ تَحْمَدُكَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
verses.web: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.
